preconditions: The cluster assumes the process heap and the NhMalloc-based operator new (0x00587C03) are initialized before the MAS loader or any list builder runs.

0x0055FC40 requires the referenced MAS archive to be findable in the working directory or in one of the search directories at 0x8B5A3C (count in 0x8B8E30); otherwise it returns an error and reports via the internal logger.
0x00545930 / 0x005518A0 / 0x00551560 require a valid owner object; a null allocation from 0x00587C03 is handled as a failure path, not a crash.
0x00587CA0 / 0x00587D02 / 0x00587F64 / 0x0058803F require a file_stream struct previously opened through the fopen wrapper (0x00587DB0); the struct carries its own critical section.
0x00589901 requires lpSrcStr to point at a writable NUL-terminated buffer: the no-string-table path modifies it in place.
0x0054C030 treats inputs a2 and a3 as tri-state (0/1/other) and expects the flag word at +0x3C to be a valid prior state before toggling.
postconditions: 0x0055FC40 returns 0 and leaves the MAS loader populated (handle +0x10, header dwords +0x114/+0x118/+0x120, size +0x11C, payload +0x128); returns -1 for empty filename, bad magic or allocation failure, and -2 when no search directory yields the file.
0x0055FE30 closes the handle at +0x10 and frees the payload at +0x128, writing 0 into both; returns 0.
0x00566650 leaves the string buffer holding a NUL-terminated copy of the input; returns 0 on success and -1 on a null input.
0x005665B0 appends a2 to the string buffer, growing and reallocating storage when the capacity at +0x04 would be exceeded.
0x00566E40 writes a 3x3 row-major rotation matrix into a2 from the three euler angles in a1; reads 3 floats, writes 9 floats.
0x00589901 returns a NUL-terminated uppercase form of the input; with the string table at 0x8D3F38 loaded it returns the interned canonical string, otherwise it uppercases in place.
0x00587CA0 returns the NUL-terminated line buffer, or null when the first read already hits EOF.
0x0054C230 returns the node at index a2 following next/+0x10 from the head at +0x204, or 0 when the index is out of range.
0x005518A0 returns 0 with *a2 set to the inserted node (or the pre-existing node on a duplicate), -1 on construction failure, -2 when the name already exists.
side_effects: func:0x00545930 allocates a 56-byte node via 0x00587C03, initializes it, links it as the new tail (next/+0x34 = 0, prev/+0x30 = old tail), appends it to the group head at node+0x2C when a3 selects a group, and increments the owner count at +0x158.

func:0x0054C030 toggles bits 1-2 of the flag word at +0x3C from inputs a2 (axis) and a3 (direction); optionally forwards the pair to the out-of-packet FlagFieldBitManipulation when the enables at +0x44/+0x4C are set.
func:0x0054C230 walks the singly-linked list from the head at +0x204 following next/+0x10; read-only.

func:0x00551560 builds a chain of 40-byte entity-list nodes (count/+0x14, data buffer/+0x18, source config/+0x1C, next/+0x24) under the owner fields +0x130/+0x134/+0x13C, copies 136-byte records from the +0x134 source, and resolves each record name at +0x44 against the mapping table in a2, writing the matched id or -1 at record +0x00.
func:0x00551830 searches the node chain from the head at +0x13C comparing the source-config name (node+0x1C then +0x1C into it) against a2; read-only.

func:0x005518A0 allocates a 52-byte node via 0x00587C03, validates a3 through sub_5508A0; on validation failure frees the node and returns -1, on duplicate name frees it and returns -2, otherwise appends to the head at +0x118 (prev/+0x2C, next/+0x30) and stores the node in *a2, returning 0.
func:0x00557470 forwards this to the empty stub EmptyStub_0170; no observable side effects (thunk).

func:0x0055FBE0 zero-initializes the MAS loader object, sets the default name at +0x14 to 'cubemas.410', and clears the handle +0x10, sizes +0x114/+0x118/+0x11C/+0x120, payload +0x128 and spare dwords +0x0C/+0x124/+0x12C/+0x130.

func:0x0055FC40 opens the MAS archive through 0x00587DB0 (with a directory search over 0x8B5A3C/0x8B8E30), reads and validates the magic header, reads header dwords into +0x114/+0x118/+0x120, allocates the payload buffer at +0x128 sized +0x11C (= +0x118<<8, incremented by 24 after the read) and fills it; on any error it closes via 0x00587D02 and reports through the internal error logger sub_53C590.
func:0x0055FE30 closes the handle at +0x10 via 0x00587D02 and frees the payload at +0x128 via 0x00587BCF, nulling both.

func:0x005651B0 rewrites the source buffer at +0x198, stripping '//' comments, handling quoted segments and paren nesting, and normalizes the token; returns a token-type code (0 regular, 1 empty/space, 2 '}' block end, 3 comment, 4 format failure).
func:0x005665B0 reallocates the string storage (free via 0x00587BCF, allocate via 0x00587C03) when the append would exceed the capacity at +0x04.
func:0x00566650 frees and reallocates the string storage when the buffer at +0x00 is null or too small for the copy.
func:0x00566E40 performs FPU math only; reads 3 floats from a1, writes 9 floats to a2.
func:0x00587BCF forwards lpMem to the internal free sub_58AA6F.
func:0x00587C03 returns NhMalloc(a1, 1); the operator-new entry point every allocator in this packet uses.
func:0x00587C20 scans the NUL-terminated string a1 for the pattern a2 and returns the match pointer or 0 (a JUMPOUT tail at 0x589DB6 handles the one-byte-pattern case).
func:0x00587CA0 reads up to a2-1 bytes or until the newline from the file_stream into a1 under a critical section, NUL-terminates it and returns it (or 0 on immediate EOF).
func:0x00587D02 closes the file_stream via MSVCCRTFileClose under a critical section; when the memory-mapped flag bit (byte +0x0C & 0x40) is set it only clears the flag instead of closing.
func:0x00587DB0 forwards (filename, mode, 64) to the fopen implementation sub_587D7F.
func:0x00587F64 runs a positioned query (sub_587F90) under a critical section.
func:0x0058803F runs a buffered read (sub_58806E, a2 x a3 bytes into a1) under a critical section.

func:0x0058815F formats a1 per the format a2 through an internal overflow-protected engine (sub_58D04D with a hard size cap), NUL-terminating on success and raising the overflow path (sub_58CF35) otherwise.
func:0x005887ED formats a2 into a1 through the length-aware engine sub_58E4D2 whose write limit is the current string length; returns -1 when the write would overflow.

func:0x00589901 uppercases the input in place; when the string table at 0x8D3F38 is loaded it interns the string through sub_591FA1 under an interlocked critical section (0x8D5A5C/0x8D5A58, lazy-init slot 19) and returns the canonical string.

unresolved: The packet aggregates a 25-function cluster. The schema's single signature anchors only on the primary entry sub_55FC40; per-function calling conventions differ across the cluster (19 __thiscall object methods, __cdecl helpers, one __fastcall for 0x00566E40, and 0x0058815F/0x005887ED which carry no convention label and were recorded as cdecl from default x86 convention).

0x0054C030 (control-input flag toggling) and 0x00566E40 (euler-to-rotation-matrix) appear semantically unrelated to content loading; they are likely grouped by the call-graph cluster cutter rather than by shared ownership.
The owner at 0x00551560 (count at +0x130) and the MAS loader spare dword at +0x130 are distinct objects that happen to share an offset value; there is no evidence they are the same struct.
0x00551560 calls out-of-packet EntityFlagSetSubInitChain and 0x0054C030 calls out-of-packet FlagFieldBitManipulation; their exact semantics are unverified here.
0x00587C20's decompile is incomplete (JUMPOUT tail at 0x589DB6); the single-byte-pattern branch when a2[1] == 0 is not fully visible.

0x0055FC40's payload-size derivation (+0x11C = +0x118 << 8) and the +24 adjustment after the payload read are not fully explained; the archive may hold an indexed table (e.g. 256 entries) whose record size is unverified.

Out-of-packet internal engines (sub_58D04D, sub_58E4D2, sub_58CF35, sub_58FCA0, sub_53C590, sub_587D7F, sub_58806E, sub_587F90, sub_58C255, NhMalloc, sub_58AA6F, sub_591FA1) were read from the raw C but not decompiled here; their exact behaviors (including the -1/-2 error conventions of 0x0058815F/0x005887ED and the 0x200 hash flags of 0x00589901) are DERIVED.
Threading: the cluster mixes load-time bootstrap (MAS open, list build, string interning) with per-frame helpers (0x0054C030, 0x00566E40); the aggregate thread requirement is classified unknown.

The string_buffer object at 0x005665B0 calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc without an explicit this in the decompile; it is treated as the same method as 0x00566650 on the shared {ptr,+0x04 capacity} layout, but the binding is inferred.
